name: Code Documentation Generator
description: Automatically generates comprehensive documentation for codebases by analyzing source files, extracting APIs, and creating formatted documentation with examples and best practices

environment_variables.name: SOURCE_PATH
environment_variables.description: Path to the source code directory or specific file to document

environment_variables.name: INCLUDE_EXAMPLES
environment_variables.description: Whether to generate usage examples for documented items (true/false)

environment_variables.name: OUTPUT_LOCATION
environment_variables.description: Directory where documentation files will be saved

environment_variables.name: DOC_STYLE
environment_variables.description: Documentation style: 'minimal' (brief descriptions), 'standard' (descriptions + params), 'comprehensive' (full with examples and cross-refs)

environment_variables.name: LANGUAGE_HINT
environment_variables.description: Optional: specify programming language if auto-detection is insufficient (e.g., 'python', 'javascript', 'rust', 'go')
